column2: Off-diagonals shrink live: 1.17, 1.10, then 0.00 at cue end with the two routes meeting at a yellow dot about (-0.81,0.15), teal Xu about (0.40,-0.30). That is diag(0.4,-0.3): confirms M1 inference for p and q. "the ends meet only when b=c=0" correct for u=(1,1), gap=(1.5b,-1.5c). Row sits at y≈434 of 540, clear of the frame bottom.
X becomes [p 0; 0 q] within 0.5 s of "So X is diagonal". Rows and arrows clear, axes brighten, F returns with "e^{tX} stretches the axes by e^{tp} and e^{tq}" on sentence 2. Correct.

Grid ×2 and ×½: horizontal spacing 95, vertical about 23.5 of a 47 base. F and square squash with it. Red outline and swatch "where A puts the F" on sentence 3 agree with sheet 275's image. e^{tp}>0 row correct. Tiles 3-4 show the opposite stretch: spacing swaps as it should. Clean.
Grid and F home by f100468; red outline stays. Purple "a half turn, then a stretch: two flows in turn" dim, see P6. On "two flows"/"running one after the other": good.

Half turn then stretch actually run: f100705 about 45°, f100735 about 135°, f100795 half turn done and stretch running, f100846 yellow F fills the red outline exactly, unit square at [-2,0]×[-½,0]. A(1,1)=(-2,-½) correct. Best picture of the chapter's claim. Rotated grid corners clip at the stage box (P1 class).

no single steady flow does both red on sentence 5. Mathematically right: -2 and -½ are distinct negative eigenvalues with single blocks. Hold to cue end, then clean cut to -I stage at f101083 on sentence 1. "both axes flipped alike:" green.

Grid plus F rotating counterclockwise about 14° at f101289; f101565 half turn done: square at [-1,0]², F exact 180° image. e^{πJ}=-I and "a steady spin, 0.5 lap" correct. Note ends about x=930 of 960 (P3).

Why does the argument fail there? runs 1693.25-1695.23 with the card still answerless; answer row arrives at sentence 4 plus 0.5 s. Rhetorical, no mark, no hold: the chapter marks only one predict. "equal stretches: (-1)-(-1)=0, no gap, so every X commutes with -I" correct and legible.
